note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20 (18 on section-image/heading combos). Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners; section images are 16:9 with square corners. Structure (matches 'Template Newsletter' + daily issues): cover -> intro paragraph -> ad #1 (top) -> 'Models & Products' h2 + section image + stories -> 'Business & Deals' h2 + section image + stories -> 'Research' h2 + section image + stories -> sign-off -> ad #2 + ad #3 (bottom) -> 'Share AI Current' button to {{rp_referral_hub_url}}. One ad at top, two at bottom.

ad_nodes.IMPORTANT_acceptance_cap: This publication has hit the ad-network accepted-opportunity cap (~69 accepted). Embedding a NEW offer from list_ad_offers (numeric id) tries to ACCEPT it and fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities', and save_post is atomic so the whole post fails. WORKAROUND: create the post WITHOUT ad nodes first, then embed ALREADY-ACCEPTED opportunities (UUID ids from list_ad_opportunities status=accepted) via edit_post_content. Do NOT set data-advertisement-kind for accepted opportunities. Insert ad #1 after the intro section, ads #2/#3 after the sign-off section (before the Share button).

recipients: No paid tiers (list_tiers=0). Default recipients = free on web + email (matches every prior issue).
